authority_meaning.contract: Part of the frozen multi-line order lifecycle contract v1. The application must satisfy it.
authority_meaning.proposed: A maintenance policy under discussion. NOT part of the application baseline; listed so the gap is explicit and no agent mistakes it for current behavior.
authority_meaning.unresolved: A requested behavior with undecided policy. Nothing executable may represent it; implementing it without a decision is inventing policy.

obligations.title: Unknown op is rejected before anything else
obligations.prose: Any op other than place/pay/ship/cancel/refund produces invalid_command regardless of version or state.

obligations.title: Version conflict is rejected before state and field validation
obligations.prose: For a known op, expected_version unequal to the current version yields conflict even when state or fields are invalid.

representations.text: orders_multi.validation.operation(command.op) == Operation.Unknown or command.expected_version == state.version or result.outcome == Outcome.Conflict

obligations.title: Illegal source status is rejected before field validation and stock
obligations.prose: For a known op at the expected version, a status from which the op is not legal yields invalid_state before any field is inspected. The legal table in orders_multi.validation.legal is the source of truth.

representations.text: orders_multi.validation.operation(command.op) == Operation.Unknown or command.expected_version != state.version or orders_multi.validation.legal(state.status, orders_multi.validation.operation(command.op)) or result.outcome == Outcome.InvalidState

obligations.title: Field validation precedes stock
obligations.prose: invalid_order precedes out_of_stock for place. Only the tests and the acceptance corpus cover this ordering; a postcondition would have to restate the field table.

representations.text: Precedence between invalid_order and out_of_stock has no runtime contract.

obligations.title: Rejected commands preserve every state field
obligations.source: CONTRACT.md, Transport: every failure leaves every state field unchanged
obligations.prose: Any outcome other than ok leaves the state structurally identical, including version, lines and stock.

obligations.title: A successful command increments the version exactly once
obligations.prose: Successful changes increment version by exactly one.

obligations.title: Initial state is empty with the supplied stock
obligations.prose: Status empty, version 0, day_placed 0, tier none, all amounts 0, no lines, stock as supplied.

representations.text: result.status == Status.Empty and result.version == 0 and result.charged_cents == 0 and result.refunded_cents == 0

obligations.title: Stock keeps every request SKU
obligations.source: CONTRACT.md, Transport: stock is an object with every SKU from the request
obligations.prose: No transition adds or removes a stock key; only counts change.

obligations.title: Placement accepts only a valid, in-stock order
obligations.source: CONTRACT.md, Placement: field validation and stock
obligations.prose: 1..5 lines, known and distinct SKUs, quantity 1..100, unit_cents 0..1000000, known category, coupon in {"", FREESHIP}, tier in {none, member, gold}, day 0..100000; every line quantity within its SKU's stock.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or orders_multi.validation.valid_order(command, state.stock) and orders_multi.inventory.sufficient(state.stock, command.lines)

obligations.title: Placement subtracts every line quantity from its SKU and charges nothing
obligations.prose: On success each line's quantity is subtracted from its SKU; status reserved; charged and refunded stay 0.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.status == Status.Reserved and result.state.charged_cents == 0 and result.state.refunded_cents == 0

obligations.title: Tier and day are taken from the placing command
obligations.prose: day_placed = command day; tier = the placing command's tier.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.tier == orders_multi.customer.tier(command.tier) and result.state.day_placed == command.day

obligations.title: Tier and day_placed are retained unchanged by every later transition
obligations.source: CONTRACT.md, Placement: tier retained; later command tier ignored
obligations.prose: Only placement writes tier and day_placed; pay, ship, cancel and refund copy them, and the tier value of any later command is ignored.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or orders_multi.validation.operation(command.op) == Operation.Place or result.state.tier == state.tier and result.state.day_placed == state.day_placed

obligations.title: Line discount is floor(gross * tier rate / 10000) with rates none 0, member 500, gold 1000
obligations.prose: Line gross = quantity * unit_cents; discount uses the placing tier's basis points; net = gross - discount.

obligations.title: Line tax is floor(net * category rate / 10000) on the discounted net with rates standard 825, food 200, exempt 0
obligations.prose: Tax basis is the line net after discount, never gross.

obligations.title: Order totals are per-line sums
obligations.source: CONTRACT.md, Pricing: subtotal, discount and tax are sums of line values
obligations.prose: subtotal_cents = sum of line nets, discount_cents = sum of line discounts (= total gross - subtotal), tax_cents = sum of line taxes; rounding is per line, never per order.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or core.list.len[Line](result.state.lines) == core.list.len[LineInput](command.lines) and orders_multi.lines.unrefunded(result.state.lines)
result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.subtotal_cents == orders_multi.lines.subtotal(result.state.lines) and result.state.tax_cents == orders_multi.lines.tax_total(result.state.lines)

obligations.title: Shipping is 0 for gold, FREESHIP or subtotal >= 10000, else 500 + 100 per extra line
obligations.prose: Shipping is computed from the placed subtotal, line count, placing tier and coupon.

representations.text: tier == Tier.Gold or coupon == "FREESHIP" or subtotal_cents >= 10000 or result == 500 + 100 * (line_count - 1)
result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.shipping_cents == orders_multi.shipping.shipping(result.state.subtotal_cents, core.list.len[Line](result.state.lines), result.state.tier, command.coupon)

obligations.title: Quoted amounts are fixed at placement and preserved by every later transition
obligations.prose: subtotal_cents, discount_cents, tax_cents and shipping_cents are written only by placement and copied unchanged by pay, ship, cancel and refund.

obligations.title: Payment charges subtotal + tax + shipping from the saved quote
obligations.prose: The charge is the saved quote, not a recomputation from the pay command; lines and stock do not change.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.charged_cents == state.subtotal_cents + state.tax_cents + state.shipping_cents
result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.status == Status.Paid and result.state.stock == state.stock and result.state.lines == state.lines

obligations.title: Shipment changes only the status
obligations.prose: ship sets status shipped and nothing else changes.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.status == Status.Shipped and result.state.stock == state.stock and result.state.lines == state.lines and result.state.charged_cents == state.charged_cents and result.state.refunded_cents == state.refunded_cents

obligations.title: Cancellation returns every line's full quantity to its SKU
obligations.prose: Reserved or paid orders may be cancelled; every line's full quantity is restocked, never a partial amount.

obligations.title: Paid cancellation refunds the whole charge including shipping and marks every line refunded; reserved cancellation refunds nothing
obligations.prose: If paid: refunded_cents = charged_cents, each line refunded_quantity = quantity and refunded_cents = net + tax (so line refunds sum to subtotal + tax while the order refund includes shipping). If reserved: refund fields stay 0 and lines are unchanged. This is the only path that refunds shipping under contract v1.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or state.status != Status.Paid or result.state.refunded_cents == state.charged_cents and orders_multi.lines.all_refunded(result.state.lines) and orders_multi.lines.refunded_total(result.state.lines) == state.subtotal_cents + state.tax_cents
result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or state.status != Status.Reserved or result.state.refunded_cents == 0 and result.state.lines == state.lines

obligations.title: Refund validation: the SKU names a line and quantity is 1..(line quantity - refunded_quantity)
obligations.prose: Otherwise invalid_refund and the state is unchanged.

representations.text: The find/quantity checks are enforced by the body; the entitled postcondition (refunded_quantity <= quantity on every line) bounds the accepted quantity but does not by itself restate the lower bound.

obligations.title: Refund window: day - day_placed must be 0..30
obligations.prose: Day 30 after placement is inside; day 31 and any day before placement are outside.

obligations.title: Per-line refund entitlement is cumulative: refunded_cents = floor((net + tax) * refunded_quantity / quantity)
obligations.prose: Each line's refunded_cents is recomputed from its cumulative refunded_quantity so split refunds never change the total; the order refunded_cents is the sum of line refunded_cents.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.lines == orders_multi.lines.refund_line(state.lines, sku, quantity)

obligations.title: Shipping is never refunded by refund
obligations.source: CONTRACT.md, Refund: shipping is never refunded by this operation
obligations.prose: After any successful refund, refunded_cents never exceeds subtotal + tax of the order.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.refunded_cents <= state.subtotal_cents + state.tax_cents

obligations.title: Refund returns exactly the refunded quantity to the line's SKU
obligations.source: CONTRACT.md, Refund: the quantity returns to the SKU's stock
obligations.prose: Stock of that SKU increases by this command's quantity only.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.stock == orders_multi.inventory.restock(state.stock, sku, quantity)

obligations.title: Status is refunded only when every line is fully refunded, else partially_refunded
obligations.prose: all_refunded over the lines decides the status after every successful refund.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or not orders_multi.lines.all_refunded(result.state.lines) or result.state.status == Status.Refunded
result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or orders_multi.lines.all_refunded(result.state.lines) or Status.PartiallyRefunded == result.state.status

obligations.title: Cumulative refunds never exceed the amount charged
obligations.prose: Across every transition refunded_cents <= charged_cents. Derived from the entitlement formula and the paid-cancel rule; it is an invariant, not a separately stated sentence of the contract.

obligations.title: Cancelled and refunded are terminal
obligations.prose: No known op is legal from cancelled or refunded; the legal table returns false for both.

representations.text: The transition table is exhaustive by construction (match over Status); no separate runtime contract restates it.

obligations.title: Snapshots report the state's version, lines and stock verbatim
obligations.prose: The presentation layer copies state fields; the adapter orders keys and sorts stock SKUs.

representations.text: result.version == transition.state.version and result.lines == transition.state.lines and result.stock == transition.state.stock

obligations.title: Tiered shipping refund on a full return
obligations.source: maintenance policy under discussion (not contract v1)
obligations.prose: Proposed: when every line of a shipped order has been returned, a member or gold customer (tier from placement) receives the original shipping charge once in addition to line entitlements. Contradicts OM-REF-004 at full return; adopting it requires a contract amendment and is not applied here.

representations.text: Not implemented. Would change the refund postcondition refunded_cents <= subtotal + tax at full return for member/gold tiers.

obligations.title: Tier eligibility is fixed at placement for the proposed refund policy
obligations.source: maintenance policy under discussion (not contract v1)
obligations.prose: Proposed: the tier used by the shipping-refund policy is the placing command's tier, never a later command's. Contract v1 already retains the tier (OM-TIER-001); listed so the dependency is explicit.

representations.text: Coincides with OM-TIER-001 in the baseline; the proposed policy only adds a consumer of the retained tier.

obligations.title: Exchanges of returned lines
obligations.prose: A customer who returned a line wants to exchange it for another SKU. Eligibility, pricing of the replacement, window, stock effect, whether an exchange counts against refunded_cents, and the resulting status are unspecified. No executable representation is permitted until decided.

representations.text: Open questions: replacement pricing and tier, window relative to placement or return, stock reservation of the new SKU, interaction with OM-REF-007 and terminal statuses.
